row: Karen Young - Safe Hands Canine Massage

As a clinical massage therapist, core conditioning coach and obsessive dog lover I want all dog owners to have access to accurate information and support so that their dog can live their best life. Clinical trials confirm that 95% of dogs that have clinical massage therapy benefit with better movement, less pain or improved sporting performance.  

This channel aims to help you understand how massage and core strength exercises are so beneficial, but also provide tips and advice to help you look after your dog so that they can live happier, healthy and long lives.
